en: A colorized view of a hilltop medieval stone castle ruin seen from a wooded foreground. Two large trees frame the image on the left and right, with dense green foliage and shrubs below. On the hill stands an elongated fortress wall with several square towers, partly collapsed, overlooking the surrounding landscape. In the top left corner, red printed text reads "Wesenberg Rakwere," indicating the location. The overall style and printing resemble an early 20th‑century picture postcard.
